subject: Chronos Analytics — Change Order request: additional capacity + fee schedule
messages:
From: Lily Zhang <lily.zhang@chronosanalytics.com>

Cc: Aaron White <aaron.white@chronosanalytics.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Change order request — additional capacity and fee schedule update

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the onboarding so far — team is making good progress. We hit a higher-than-expected data ingestion window for Q2 and need to request an interim change order rather than waiting for the annual renewal. High-level ask:

- Add 60,000 GPU-hours (burst + reserve) to our Dedicated pool (Chronos account).
- Update the fee schedule for the added capacity to a blended rate; current rate on Order Form is $0.92/hr. We propose $0.78/hr for the incremental capacity for the first 6 months.
- Confirm that usage for the added capacity will be billed monthly in arrears and not included in prepaid pool commitment for the calendar year.

Attached is a short word doc with the requested quantities and a proposed effective start date of 2027-03-01. We also need clarity on whether the requested change requires an MSA amendment or a standalone change order.

Can you confirm next steps and an estimated turnaround for legal? We are under an internal deadline to enable the extra capacity by March first.

Thanks,
Lily Zhang
Head of ML Engineering
Chronos Analytics

Subject: Re: Change order request — additional capacity and fee schedule update

Lily — thanks for the clear brief and the doc. We can support an accelerated path on this. Quick notes and next steps from our side:

1) Intake & routing: I’ve looped in Ben (AE) and Rishi (Legal). Ben will confirm commercial terms; Rishi will advise on whether this is an MSA amendment or a change order.

2) Billing trigger: can you confirm whether the incremental 60k should live as a named ‘Dedicated reserve’ (monthly drawdown) or as an on-demand burst pool? That affects whether we treat it as a prepaid commitment or a monthly variable add-on.

3) Start date: you requested 2027-03-01. We will aim to have a signed document before that date; legal turnaround target 48–72 hours after Ben posts the first redline. If we can’t get signatures, we can provision a temporary burst pool subject to written confirmation on billability (we’ll need an exec approval for that).

Please see HubSpot link for our internal deal (I’ll add notes): https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9988776

Ben — can you draft a change-order redline and a short note that summarizes the blended fee calculation? Rishi — if you can scan for any non-standard MSA clauses (billing cycle, rollback, fee protection), please flag them.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Draft: Chronos change order + proposed fee language

Team — attaching a short redline that converts Chronos’ request into a change order and a proposed fee schedule table. Key commercial points I used:

- Incremental 60,000 GPU-hours treated as a 6-month supplemental capacity add-on, billed monthly in arrears.
- Blended incremental rate proposed: $0.78/hr for incremental usage only; base pool unchanged.
- Early termination: standard MSA termination applies, but we propose a 30-day notice for reducing the supplemental capacity after the 6-month term.
- Waiver request from Chronos to not have the incremental capacity count against existing annual commitment; we should decide if we accept.

Rishi — two legal points for your review (see highlighted in RI_redline_CO_20270215.docx):
1) Section 3(b) — billing and invoice timing: Chronos proposes monthly arrears; confirm whether we need an explicit clause for invoicing format and audit rights.
2) Section 6 — price protection: Chronos is asking for a fixed blended rate for first 6 months. Legal should add language that allows a price review after 90 days if cost inputs materially change.

I’ll hold the draft until legal gives the green light to send to Chronos.

[Attachment: RI_redline_CO_20270215.docx (docx)]

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Draft: Chronos change order + proposed fee language (legal comments)

Ben / Kim / Marissa — reviewed the redline and Chronos request. High-level legal guidance:

- Structure: This is best handled as a standalone Change Order to the Order Form (rather than an MSA amendment) because there are no permanent changes to the MSA terms, only to quantities and fees. That keeps scope limited and faster to execute.

- Billing & audit: Accept monthly arrears. Add an explicit invoicing section requiring 30-day net payment and a capped 60-day window for post-billing audits (to limit exposure).

- Price protection: We can agree to the $0.78/hr blended rate for the first 90 days with the option to re-open pricing after 90 days if our average infra cost delta exceeds 7%. Add a mutual-conducted review clause to trigger renegotiation.

- Commencement & provisioning: Do not back-date. Proposed start 2027-03-15 to give ops 10 business days to provision and to avoid rushed capacity errors. If Chronos needs provisional access earlier, require an email PO plus an authorization from their Director of Finance accepting provisional billing terms.

- SLA and liability: For any new burst capacity, add a short SLA note for throughput but do not expand liability beyond the MSA.

I’ve attached a legal redline (redline_msa_v3.docx) and summarized the specific edits in the doc. Once you incorporate the three small commercial adjustments above, we can share a clean change order to Chronos for countersignature.

[Attachment: redline_msa_v3.docx (docx)]

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.com

Subject: Chronos Change Order: proposed language and next steps

Lily / Aaron — thanks for your patience. Attached is the proposed Change Order that incorporates the commercial and legal guardrails we discussed:

Summary of material points (high level):
- Incremental capacity: +60,000 GPU-hours as a 6-month supplemental pool.
- Blended incremental rate: $0.78/hr for incremental usage for the first 90 days; price review clause thereafter (see Section 4).
- Billing: monthly in arrears; invoices due net 30; 60-day window for audits.
- Commencement: target provisioning date 2027-03-15. If you require earlier, please confirm in writing (email from your Director of Finance) to allow provisional provisioning.
- Termination: 30-day notice for reduction after the 6-month term.

Next steps: please review the attached PDF (clean + signature packet) and let us know if you accept as-is or propose redlines. We can accept countersignature via DocuSign or a signed PDF returned to the mailbox.

If you need us to accelerate provisioning before 3/15 we can do an interim burst but we’ll need the written authorization above.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this finalized quickly so ops can provision.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
